---
title: next-site deployment
description: Building and running next-site's Docker image.
sidebar:
  label: Deployment
---

The image is Next's standalone server with Payload inside. It builds without a
database.

```sh
docker build --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=https://example.com -t site .
docker run -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env.production -v site-media:/app/media site
```

- **Runtime:** `DATABASE_URL`, `PAYLOAD_SECRET`, and the SMTP settings.
- **Build:** `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL` (and the `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENOBSERVE_*`
  values for browser monitoring). `build.sh <env>` reads them from the env file.
- **Volume:** `/app/media`, or uploads are lost with the container.
- **Migrations** run when the server starts. Create the first one
  (`yarn payload migrate:create initial`) before the first deploy.
- **Health:** `GET /api/health` answers 200 when the server and database are up.

See [Email (SMTP)](../../../services/smtp/) and
[PostgreSQL](../../../services/postgres/) for the services it connects to.
